mentions.author: squarefoot
mentions.story: We Made Amiga, They Fucked It Up (2015)
mentions.why: Demonstrates CygnusEd's famously fast scrolling on 8 MHz Amiga hardware.
mentions.quote: For those who never used CED on an Amiga, this is how it ran on now 30 years old hardware clocked at 8 MHz.

mentions.author: squarefoot
mentions.story: Slap – A Sublime-like terminal-based text editor
mentions.why: Shows how fast a graphical editor scrolled on an 8 MHz Amiga.
mentions.quote: this is how a graphical text editor scrolled text 30 years ago on a 8 MHz 16 bit machine!
